faults.title: Knocking tailgate (Mk2)
faults.description: On the 2012-2019 Mk2, a knock from the rear may be the tailgate striker plate, which needs greasing.

faults.title: Creaking front doors (Mk2)
faults.description: Creaks from the front doors are common. Auto Express says treating the rubber seals should fix it.

faults.title: Cracked cylinder head and clutch recalls (Mk2)
faults.description: 2018 recalls covered cylinder heads that could crack and leak pressurised oil (sometimes causing fires) on some earlier cars, and clutch pressure plates that could fracture on some EcoBoost manuals.

faults.title: Plug-in hybrid battery recalls (Mk3)
faults.description: Three 2020 recalls targeted the 2020-on Mk3 PHEV: a damaged battery control connector, battery packs that could overheat, and short circuits inside the battery.

faults.title: Oil/fuel leak and glass roof recalls (Mk3)
faults.description: Auto Express mentions a campaign to tackle oil and fuel leaks in Mk3 Kugas built up to summer 2022, and a November 2022 recall for glass roofs detaching on some 2021-built cars. Check any Mk3's recall history.
